### 🎯 Purpose

Explain what this PR does and why it’s needed.

### 🧩 Related Issues

Closes #[issue-number] or references other tickets.

### 🧠 Summary of Changes

- [ ] Added new feature
- [ ] Fixed a bug
- [ ] Updated documentation
- [ ] Refactored code
- [ ] Other (describe below)

### 🔍 Testing

Describe how this was tested:

- [ ] Local test suite
- [ ] Browser/device checks
- [ ] CI checks passed

### 🧱 Screenshots / Evidence

If applicable, add screenshots, logs, or metrics.

### 🗂️ Notes for Reviewers

List areas that need closer review or clarification.

**Checklist:**

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, etc.)
- [ ] Lint, build, and test pass locally
- [ ] Documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] No sensitive data committed
